title: l1qw.32(b) remainder: /config/privacy + /config/privacy/allowed C resources
description: Remainder of ulum (l1qw.32(b)) after the 4.01-body slice landed: coap_config.c (or a sibling resource) must expose /config/privacy (GET mode) and /config/privacy/allowed (PUT {peers:[...]}) replacing the single-peer whitelist in the C coap subsystem, with host tests in lichen/tests/coap_location_beacon (now buildable again after the Kconfig fix in upk4). Coordinate the body shapes with l1qw.32(a) Python.
